rule: Recovered historical reader defects are acceptance tests or explicit blockers. A green unit suite does not close entries whose required runtime/browser evidence is still missing.

entries.defect: Host elevation state could fire on the words cue before the actual elevation action.
entries.invariant: AO.SM.C0173 is words only; AO.SM.C0174 owns Host elevation action.

entries.defect: Chalice elevation state could fire before the actual elevation action.
entries.invariant: AO.SM.C0180 remains words; AO.SM.C0181 owns Chalice elevation action.

entries.defect: Gesture/response/bell/cinematic state could survive a card change.
entries.invariant: No transient state from the prior card may render before the next exact cue owns the new card.

entries.defect: Earlier reader composition merged Gradual with Alleluia/Tract content.
entries.invariant: B021 is the Gradual reader surface; B022 is separate Alleluia/Tract Schola content; B023 begins Munda cor meum.

entries.defect: Paragraph synchronization could overwrite transient action/gesture ownership.
entries.invariant: State-only updates do not rebuild prayer paragraphs and exact cue state remains channel-owned.

entries.defect: A prior reader build overwrote document.title with a stale prototype/version title.
entries.invariant: R17 modular Mass source must not mutate document.title.

entries.defect: Transient badges could clone oversized embedded icon/image payloads.
entries.invariant: R17 modular Mass/presentation source must not embed data:image payloads; approved icon assets must be referenced through the asset-bank resolver.

entries.defect: A historical audit referenced stale rt.parts rather than the authoritative parts registry.
entries.invariant: R17 tests consume explicit modular contracts rather than a legacy rt.parts audit alias.

entries.defect: Pax Domini, the private peace prayer and the Solemn ministerial Pax transfer must not be conflated.
entries.invariant: MC-COM-100 remains Pax Domini; plan projection may suppress MC-COM-150 and MC-COM-160 independently without mutating the frozen canonical graph.
